messages.subject: lavaan worskhop(s) in Ghent, 9-12 April
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

In April, I teach two lavaan workshops in Ghent (Belgium):

1) Introduction to Structural Equation Modeling (9+10 April)

https://www.ugent.be/we/en/services/ICES/courses/dataanalysis2017-2018/m6

2) Multilevel Structural Equation Modeling (11+12 April)

https://www.ugent.be/we/en/services/ICES/courses/dataanalysis2017-2018/m7

Feel free to forward this to everyone who might be interested.

Yves.
